name: U.S. States
description: U.S. States word search puzzles place common state names and a few map words — Alabama, Alaska, Colorado, border, coast, capital — into free online grids for adults and seniors. Easy, medium, hard and large print are all available. No timer, no account and no political campaign brands: just geography English many readers already know. Written to be large-print friendly and calm rather than competitive. Continue with World Capitals, American History, Presidents or Travel when you want a wider map session. New here? See how to play. If letters look small on your device, start with a large-print states puzzle.
